meta.name: orchestration
meta.description: Use Orca orchestration for structured multi-agent coordination: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply flows, task dispatch, worker_done/escalation waits, task DAGs, decision gates, coordinator loops, or decomposing work across agents. Use `orca-cli` instead for full ownership handoffs, including requests phrased as "hand off", "handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", or "another worktree" when the user did not explicitly ask to supervise, monitor, wait for results, or coordinate a DAG. Use `orca-cli` for ordinary terminal control, lightweight terminal prompts, shell commands, Orca worktree management, reading or waiting on terminals, and automation of the browser embedded inside Orca. Use Computer Use for browser windows, webviews, Orca app UI, or desktop UI outside Orca's embedded browser.

copy.tagline: 协调多个智能体分工协作完成任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要把一个大任务拆成多个助手并行处理并汇总结果。
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate multiple AI agents to split and execute complex tasks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple AI assistants and need structured task coordination.

howto.what: 装上后,当 Claude 需要协调多个代理时,它会先确定要用的 Orca 程序,再通过该程序调出与版本匹配的使用说明,然后照着说明执行任务分发、等待 worker 结果、编排任务 DAG 等操作。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 协调多个代理,并明确要监督、等待结果或编排任务 DAG 时触发,例如任务分发、决策门、协调器循环等。

say.text: 把这两个任务分派给两个代理,等它们都完成后汇总结果。
say.note: 这会触发任务分发并等待 worker 完成。

say.text: 用 Orca 编排一个任务 DAG:先抓取数据,再跑分析,最后汇总。
say.note: 这会让 Claude 按依赖顺序执行各步骤并等待完成。

say.text: 设置一个决策门:根据中间结果决定走哪条分支。
say.note: 这会触发决策门,让 Claude 依据结果选择后续路径。

howto.what_en: When multi-agent coordination is needed, Claude picks the right Orca executable, uses it to fetch the version-matched guide, then follows it to dispatch tasks, wait for worker results, or orchestrate task DAGs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to coordinate multiple agents and explicitly supervise, wait for results, or orchestrate a DAG — e.g., task dispatch, decision gates, coordinator loops.

say_en.text: Dispatch these two tasks to two agents and summarize once both are done.
say_en.note: This triggers task dispatch and waits for worker completion.

say_en.text: Orchestrate a task DAG with Orca: fetch data, then analyze, then finalize.
say_en.note: This runs steps in order and waits for completion.

say_en.text: Set a decision gate: pick the next branch based on the intermediate result.
say_en.note: This triggers a decision gate to choose the next path.
